sources.text:
Tidewell Bike Share - Help Centre FAQ (2025 edition)

How much is an annual pass?
For 2025, the annual pass is £84. It covers unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes.

How long can I keep a bike before extra charges start?
You can ride for 30 minutes on any pass before extra time is charged. After that, every additional 15 minutes costs £1.

Can I take a bike on the train?
Tidewell bikes may not be taken on trains or buses, because they must stay within the service area.

Do I need a helmet?
Helmets are recommended but not required. Tidewell does not provide helmets.

What happens if I lose my membership card?
You can unlock bikes with the app instead. A replacement card costs £3 and arrives within five working days.

sources.text:
Tidewell Bike Share - Member Terms (valid from 1 March 2026)

Passes
An annual pass costs £96 and includes unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes each. A monthly pass costs £12. A day pass costs £4 and can be bought at any docking station with a contactless card. Students with a valid university card get 25% off the annual pass.

Ride time and extra charges
If a ride lasts longer than 45 minutes, each additional 15 minutes costs £1. Electric bikes carry a surcharge of 10p per minute on every pass. Riders must be at least 16 years old; riders aged 16 or 17 need a parent or guardian to accept these terms on their behalf.

sources.label: S3
sources.title: Tidewell Bike Share - Member Terms (valid from 1 March 2026)
sources.text:
Returning bikes
Bikes must be returned to a Tidewell docking station. A bike left outside a docking station is charged a recovery fee of £25. If a station is full, the app shows the nearest station with a free dock and adds 15 minutes of free ride time.

Damage and theft
Report damage within 24 hours through the app. Members are not charged for normal wear. A stolen bike must be reported to the police and to Tidewell within 48 hours; if both reports are made in time, the member pays nothing for the bike.

Cancelling
A monthly pass can be cancelled at any time and ends at the close of the month already paid. An annual pass can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund. After 14 days, annual passes are not refunded.

sources.text:
Copperfield Makerspace - Membership Handbook

Opening hours
The makerspace is open from 10:00 to 22:00 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 18:00 at weekends. It is closed on public holidays.

Membership
Standard membership costs £35 per month and gives access during all opening hours. Off-peak membership costs £20 per month and is limited to weekdays before 16:00. Members can bring one guest per visit; guests must sign the visitor book and stay with the member at all times.

sources.label: S5
sources.title: Copperfield Makerspace - Membership Handbook
sources.text:
Equipment
Members may use the 3D printers, the electronics bench and the sewing machines without booking. The laser cutter and the CNC router must be booked through the members' portal, for at most two hours per session. Filament for the 3D printers is sold at reception at 5p per gram; members may also bring their own filament.

Inductions
Before using the laser cutter, every member must complete a one-hour laser induction, which costs £15. Members do not need an induction for the 3D printers.

Storage
Each standard member gets one storage box. Projects left on the shared tables overnight are moved to the lost property shelf and recycled after 30 days.

Leaving
Membership can be cancelled with one month's notice. The joining fee of £10 is not refunded.

sources.text:
Copperfield Makerspace - Workshop Safety Rules

Wood shop
Safety glasses must be worn at all times in the wood shop. Loose clothing and long hair must be tied back before using the table saw or the lathe. Nobody may use the table saw alone: a second member must be in the room.

Laser cutter
No induction is needed to use the laser cutter; members only have to read the safety sheet next to the machine. Never leave the laser cutter running unattended. Do not cut PVC or vinyl, which release toxic gas.

Soldering
Use the fume extractor whenever you solder. Lead-free solder is provided free of charge.

Children
Children under 14 may visit the makerspace with a parent but may not use any power tools. Members aged 14 to 17 may use power tools only under the direct supervision of a staff member.

The laser cutter and the CNC router must be booked through the members' portal, for at most two hours per session. Filament for the 3D printers is sold at reception at 5p per gram; members may also bring their own filament.

Inductions
Before using the laser cutter, every member must complete a one-hour laser induction, which costs £15. Members do not need an induction for the 3D printers.

Storage
Each standard member gets one storage box. Projects left on the shared tables overnight are moved to the lost property shelf and recycled after 30 days.

Leaving
Membership can be cancelled with one month's notice. The joining fee of £10 is not refunded.

Copperfield Makerspace - Workshop Safety Rules

Wood shop
Safety glasses must be worn at all times in the wood shop. Loose clothing and long hair must be tied back before using the table saw or the lathe. Nobody may use the table saw alone: a second member must be in the room.

Laser cutter
No induction is needed to use the laser cutter; members only have to read the safety sheet next to the machine. Never leave the laser cutter running unattended. Do not cut PVC or vinyl, which release toxic gas.

Soldering
Use the fume extractor whenever you solder. Lead-free solder is provided free of charge.

Children
Children under 14 may visit the makerspace with a parent but may not use any power tools. Members aged 14 to 17 may use power tools only under the direct supervision of a staff member.

sources.text:
Returning bikes
Bikes must be returned to a Tidewell docking station. A bike left outside a docking station is charged a recovery fee of £25. If a station is full, the app shows the nearest station with a free dock and adds 15 minutes of free ride time.

Damage and theft
Report damage within 24 hours through the app. Members are not charged for normal wear. A stolen bike must be reported to the police and to Tidewell within 48 hours; if both reports are made in time, the member pays nothing for the bike.

Cancelling
A monthly pass can be cancelled at any time and ends at the close of the month already paid. An annual pass can be cancelled within 14 days of purchase for a full refund. After 14 days, annual passes are not refunded.

Tidewell Bike Share - Member Terms (valid from 1 March 2026)

Passes
An annual pass costs £96 and includes unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes each. A monthly pass costs £12. A day pass costs £4 and can be bought at any docking station with a contactless card. Students with a valid university card get 25% off the annual pass.

Ride time and extra charges
If a ride lasts longer than 45 minutes, each additional 15 minutes costs £1. Electric bikes carry a surcharge of 10p per minute on every pass. Riders must be at least 16 years old; riders aged 16 or 17 need a parent or guardian to accept these terms on their behalf.

The makerspace is open from 10:00 to 22:00 on weekdays and from 09:00 to 18:00 at weekends. It is closed on public holidays.
